specialRules.ruleFull: Several of the warband's members are wanted thieves. A captured thief may be sold for 1D6 gold crowns plus his experience. Roll a D6 once he is sold: on a 1-3 one of his hands is chopped off; on a 4-5 he is burned with hot irons and branded on the forehead, which counts as a deep chest wound, so he loses 1 Toughness and is at -3 on his rolls to find items; on a 6 he is executed.
Add +1 to the warband's rolls to find items.
Any warrior within 6" of the Guild Master may use his Leadership instead of his own.
The Guild Master counts as a known thief.
The Master Thief counts as a known thief.

Whenever the warband rolls for what it finds after a battle in a city or at an oasis with a caravan, each Beggar may beg. Roll a D6 for him: on a 2-6 he is given D3 gold crowns, and on a 1 he is beaten and misses the next battle.

specialSkillsList.name: Sticky Fingers
specialSkillsList.description: A model taken out of action is left on the table. If the Hero moves into base contact with him he may try to steal one of his weapons, succeeding on a 5+ on a D6. The attempt takes his whole turn and he may do nothing else that turn.

specialSkillsList.name: Knife Fighting (Arabyan Theives)
specialSkillsList.description: While the Hero fights with knives in hand-to-hand combat he adds +1 to his Weapon Skill and +1 to the injury rolls he causes with them. His enemy still gets its +1 armour save against a knife.

specialSkillsList.name: Hide in Shadows (Arabyan Theives)
specialSkillsList.description: While the Hero is within 1" of a wall or other linear obstacle, an opposing model must pass an Initiative test to charge him.

specialSkillsList.name: Sheer Speed
specialSkillsList.description: Guild Master and Master Thief only. The Hero adds +1 to his Movement.

flags.what: The PDF prints no starting gold, only "Maximum warband number is 15". The template carries our 500 gc default.

Knowing the trade routes also says "All heroes in the thief warband may gain the Disarm/Spot trap skill". That is our Trap Expert, so it is a skill of the warband's own group (every Hero ticks Special) rather than a sentence in the warband rule. See the decisions.
Known thieves: a captured thief sells for "1D6+ the model exprience", read as 1D6 gold crowns plus his experience. The chopped-off hand on a 1-3 is given no effect in the PDF; as printed.

The PDF's Hide in Shadows (an Initiative test to charge him while he is within 1" of a wall, said to be the Imperial Assassin's skill) and Knife fighting (+1 WS and +1 to injury with knives) are not what our skills of those names do, so each is a new skill named apart. See the decisions.

"Scimitar" at 15 gc is our Sword (its tags hold the name), so the Thieves list sells our Sword at 10 gc and at 15 gc as printed. Jambiya is our Dagger. Ankus and Cutlass are stubs with no rules; the Scythe stub is the one the Vampire Hunters brought.
No group sizes are printed for the Thieves or the Beggars, and the Beggars have no maximum.
